name: well
description: The Well (well, well_2), rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49.1 (tools/blueprints/briefs/well.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py well well --candidate --nbt out/well.nbt && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py well well_2 --candidate --nbt out/well-2.nbt
